description.en: A clearing beyond Rainmarket. Smoke rises from distant cottages, and the forest muffles the noise of town.
description.zh-CN: 雨集镇外的一片空地。远处农舍升起炊烟，林木隔开了镇上的喧闹。

description.en: A dancer and spellcaster rehearsing in the clearing.
description.zh-CN: 一位舞者兼施法者，正在空地上排练。

夜晚独自抚琴的曲非烟…….en: Speak with Okuni. With Musashi, this meeting leads to a battle; save and prepare first.
夜晚独自抚琴的曲非烟…….zh-CN: 与阿国交谈。武藏同行时，这次会面会接着开战；请先保存并做好准备。

description.en: Izumo no Okuni joined the party.

en: A clearing, a breeze, no audience. I thought this would be a peaceful rehearsal.
Would an audience of one ruin it?
Depends. Can you applaud quietly? I'm trying to think.
Something troubling you?
An unfinished argument. Forgive me—some things won't leave your head just because you've left town.
zh-CN: 空地、微风、没有观众。我还以为，这回能安安静静地排练。
多一个观众，会打扰你吗？
得看情况。你能小声鼓掌吗？我正想事情。
遇到烦心事了？
一场没吵完的争执。抱歉——有些事，不是离开了镇子就能忘掉的。

en: I've practiced this dance until my feet know it better than I do. My mind is still back in town.
A difficult audience?
Benkei broke up our performance. Apparently, if he doesn't like the show, nobody gets to see it.
Were you hurt?
I got away. The others scattered. Now every rehearsal turns into an argument with someone who isn't here.
Okuni? I wondered who was arguing with the trees.
Musashi! At last, someone who knows when to stand still.
I saw Benkei strike at you. When you fell, I thought I'd arrived too late.
He missed. Years of falling onstage finally came in handy. Getting up was less graceful.
Your troupe made a bare patch of road worth stopping for. I'd rather hear that music than another argument.
So would I. But he keeps finding us.
There you are! Dancers, swordsmen—trouble, all of you. Guards, take them!
Stay with us, Okuni. We'll face him together.
zh-CN: 这支舞练得连脚都比我熟了，可脑子还留在镇上。
遇上难伺候的观众了？
弁庆赶散了我们的演出。看来，只要他不爱看，谁也别想看。
你受伤了吗？
我逃出来了，其他人也四散躲开。现在一排练，就像在和一个不在场的人吵架。
阿国？我还在想，是谁跟树吵起来了。
武藏！总算来了个知道什么时候该站稳的人。
我看到弁庆朝你出手。你倒下时，我以为自己来晚了。
他没打中。多年在台上练的跌倒，总算派上用场。就是爬起来时不太好看。
你们的演出，能让人愿意在一块光秃秃的路边停下。我宁愿再听到那音乐，也不想听争吵。
我也想。可他总能找上门。
原来在这儿！舞者、剑客——全是惹事的。守卫，把他们拿下！
阿国，别离我们太远。一起迎敌。

en: Enough! Guards, fall back. This isn't over!
He ruins a show, then won't even stay for the ending.
Let him go. Chasing him won't bring your audience back.
I know. I miss performing without watching every face for a threat.
Then keep your eyes on the stage. We'll watch the road.
Let me travel with you. I'll bring my spells—and this Sun and Moon Lash Tome. A little light, a little sting. Good for an encore.
Welcome aboard. Keep the tome for study; carrying it won't do the practicing for you.
zh-CN: 够了！守卫，撤退。此事没完！
砸了别人的演出，连结尾都不肯看。
让他走吧。追上去，也找不回你的观众。
我知道。我只是想好好演出，不用盯着每张脸，猜谁又要来找麻烦。
那你看好舞台。我们看着路。
让我和你们同行吧。法术归我，这本日月法鞭法术书也带上。一点光，再添一点刺，返场正合适。
欢迎同行。法术书留着研习；光把书带在身上，可不算练过。
